reviews.title: No VisionPro Support
reviews.text: I am extremely disappointed to find the app is blocked on VisionPro. Although the VisionPro user base is small, it costs you nothing to allow the app to work as an iPad app. I cannot justify paying for this service until it works on VisionPro.

reviews.title: Pricing is awful
reviews.text: With Marvel Unlimited you pay a single set price that lets you read all Marvel comics in the app. For the DC app there are different prices depending on if you want to be able to read new releases. This makes it difficult to read a full series. The pricing is also higher.

reviews.title: Updates
reviews.text: Paying 11.99 for something you’re going to update only when you feel like it is a spit in the face. You know that there is no reason to buy soo many comics when there isn’t a serialized or canon comic. I want to read what i enjoy and paying soo much when updates are soo little is highway robbery. Your japanese contemporaries charge 3.99 because they know that people are not buying EVERY comic issue and they don’t wait till a month after to drop releases. Using you get to read everything is not the justification you think it is. In fact, it’s no justification at all. Be real with yourselves. Comics in general suck compared to your Japanese and korean colleagues. Only thing i want to read is being held up. Update absolute wonder woman already. By the way all the other absolute comics other than wonder woman suck.

reviews.title: Poor service
reviews.text: I have good internet connection and full 4 bars of service, but I still cannot open the app and read my comic when I’d like to. It takes away from the convenience of using this app if I can only use it at my house. Please update the app so it could be used with mobile data while on the road, so I can read the comic stories I grew up loving.

reviews.title: You can’t read anything
reviews.text: You used to be able to read a couple of comics here and there without a subscription but now basically everything needs premium even things from like 2014 and earlier. Not to mention I got a subscription for a year and it only counted for a couple months before I lost access to them completely, so I wouldn’t even risk buying a subscription since they might just take it away. Debatably worse they will change the tier of the book you’re currently reading so you will just lose access to it halfway through. I’m extremely disappointed to have to rate this as low as I did because I used to love this app.

reviews.title: Can’t subscribe… can’t read anything
reviews.text:
Used to love this app but when it came time to resubscribe I get an error message “Product not found in App Store catalog” o.O
*sigh*

Back to good ol’ paper comix

reviews.title: Not a lot of creeper
reviews.text: When I got this I thought I was gonna be able to read all the comics with my favourite character the creeper in them only to find out a whole bunch of his series are missing and the only ones there are the 1 issues of his million and the rest are the version where’s he’s in Paris and is a woman I don’t mind them but more variety was expected from something call dc universe INFINITE

reviews.title: Doesn’t work with panel to panel
reviews.text:
When I enable panel to panel, it becomes frustratingly inconsistent, trying to get to the next panel. It doesn’t let me swipe it for some reason. Instead, the only thing that seems to work sometimes is tapping on the edge of the comic panel to move it to the next one, but even that spotty at best. I tried deleting the app and reinstalling. I’ve tried restarting my phone. I’ve tried logging out and logging back in with no luck still the same issue. I’m not sure why this happens because it also does it on my iPad as well.
Besides that issue, it’s a good app and I just end up using the web browser to avoid this problem altogether

reviews.title: Terrible Interface
reviews.text: This has a horrible interface for actually reading comics. It’s ok on a tablet and a nightmare on a phone. Why can’t it just be as intuitive as Kindle or Marvel Unlimited??

reviews.title: Page swipe
reviews.text: Page swipe is so annoying on dc, it now won’t swipe unless you do it 7 to 8 times . Marvel app is seamless with swiping

reviews.title: New update makes reading near impossible on iPad M1 Pro
reviews.text: My previous review was four stars for lack of arrow navigation. They finally added it, except either form of navigation now only works about half the time. It was buttery smooth before this update. I wish I could just read on my iPad on the web, but there’s just a constant banner telling me to use the broken app.

reviews.title: Downloading Doesn't Work
reviews.text:
As someone who uses trains and planes a lot, meaning I often don't have internet, it's extremely frustrating that the download feature on DC Universe Infinite is so completely useless. 

Even comics that are marked as downloaded won't load when you try to open them, and then when you close them they'll reveal that they were still in the process of downloading. Then that download will just stop for no discernible reason.

This is true across different generations of iPhone and iPad apps; it seems to be a fundamental issue across the app.

reviews.title: Missing Key Issues
reviews.text: This app is good if you want some of the more popular runs or to skim through a lot of different heroes. But it’s missing too many key issues to be a good app. Batman #49 introduces both Vicki Vale and Mad Hatter. And not available. If I can’t read expensive issues that i otherwise wouldn’t be able to read, what’s the appeal?

reviews.title: Lacks a crucial feature that should be standard in 2026
reviews.text: WHY does this app not have dual-screen, landscape functionality for its comic reading? Its competition, such as ComiXology, has this in spades. It’s super annoying and absolutely ridiculous to still have this issue in 2026, especially when this app is sure to have plenty of readers via iPad OS. Pathetic.

reviews.title: Panel view is too hard to read
reviews.text:
I don't love the marvel app, but it's much better than this app.

They at least do panel view properly so you can actually the read the story.

Also, pinch to zoom doesn't work very well (marvel has the same problem). At first I thought it was my new iPad air m3, but it's not - pinch to zoom works fine on chrome and safari.

Also, there's no way to see which comics were recently added - they have a section for recently added to ultra, but if you don't have ultra, that does you no good 👎

reviews.title: All of my downloads removed
reviews.text: Every six months or so the app will log me out and delete all of my downloaded issues.  This will occur randomly and does not appear to be related to any updates.  Customer service is useless.  If the back catalog was not so impressive this app would not be worth using.  Very poor experience
